capabilities: embed .eml files inline in notes via ![[file.eml]]
open .eml files full-width in their own tab
render the HTML email body in a sandboxed iframe with height fitting
block remote images and trackers until explicitly loaded
list attachments with size and open them via the OS default app
extras: Also installable via the BRAT beta plugin; the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian treats .eml files as opaque attachments, so emails referenced in notes cannot be read inline.

relations.evidence: Robust MIME parsing (charsets, encoded-word headers, quoted-printable / base64, nested multipart) via postal-mime.

summary: Embeds .eml email files in notes, rendering headers, an HTML body in a sandboxed iframe, inline images, and attachments.
